keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: Of course it is. Of course she gave you one.

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: Transfer slips. Archive courtyard, under the blue drain tile. Your mother took the registers.

keeper.speaker: TAVO
keeper.text: Why do you know my mother?

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: I told myself I was only counting.

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: I put the numbers where their names had been.

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: Don't let them make you the answer again.
